# Ben Court

## About
Ben Court is a Cardiff-based senior front-end developer currently working at Utility Warehouse. His work focuses on front-end engineering, accessibility, performance optimisation, and progressive web applications.

## Background
Ben has over fifteen years of professional web development experience and has worked across agency, in-house product, and startup environments. He has a strong focus on mobile-first design, accessible interfaces, and front-end architecture.

## Experience
- Senior Software Engineer at Utility Warehouse (Dec 2023 – Present)
- Senior Software Engineer at Roku (Aug 2023 – Dec 2023)
- Senior Front End Engineer at Sonovate (Jan 2022 – Aug 2023)
- Front End Engineer at Studee (Nov 2020 – Jan 2022)
- Senior Front End Developer at Inspiretec (Oct 2019 – Nov 2020)
- Senior Front End Developer at TrakCel (Aug 2019 – Oct 2019)
- Web Developer at Pi-top (Sep 2018 – Aug 2019)
- Front End Developer at Inspiretec (Mar 2018 – Sep 2018)
- Senior UI Developer at Hitched (Aug 2016 – Mar 2018)
- Front End Developer at Eteach (Aug 2015 – Aug 2016)
- Front End Developer at The Strategies Group (May 2012 – Aug 2015)
- Junior Web Designer/Developer at Snailwhale (May 2011 – May 2012)
